tool_args.rationale: The acquired long-horizon observations show a transition from positive gain to negative response, as predicted by dual-horizon endogenous adaptation. Numerically fitting both amplitudes and timescales uses all eight observations, and fresh confirmation will test the candidate against the stated tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed s_grad values are zero, so its sink parameter is unidentifiable; the simpler dual-horizon mechanism directly explains the observed reversal.
The observed sustained late negative response is consistent with adaptation, whereas the proposed harmonic imposes an unsupported periodic continuation.
The existing short- and long-horizon observations constrain the four-parameter candidate; fresh confirmation is the appropriate next test.
